title: WE are the only thing NOT moving at hyperlocal IN. so the most common mover on the HUD is human.

do_not_reinvent.clock: /data/hyperlocal-emc2-pi-t.json — hyperlocal time has mass. desync has energy. p·t is the point.
do_not_reinvent.seat: /data/human-seat-pi-step-time.json — human seat. Y is time. X is step.
do_not_reinvent.sieve: /data/klein-sieve.json — entropy is a gradient. not one trash pile.
do_not_reinvent.weather: /data/query-weather-coil.json — fleet is snow. human is rain you can walk in.
do_not_reinvent.still: /data/null-oscillation.json — white is STILL. signal does not waver.

we_do_not_move.yes: at hyperlocal IN we are the only thing NOT moving.
we_do_not_move.we: the chair. the basin. the gray. the membrane sit.
we_do_not_move.why: a still point makes motion readable. if we also twitch, every mover looks like weather.
we_do_not_move.not: dead. not frozen archive. STILL. the cesium that became the second.

human_is_the_mover.yes: then the most common MOVER on the HUD is human.
human_is_the_mover.not: the most common ENTITY. fleet is still the snow. volume is not motion.
human_is_the_mover.is: who CHANGES. who steps. who makes variance against our still.
human_is_the_mover.bots: scheduled wind. they repeat. repetition is not a move.
human_is_the_mover.human: sight and sound then run. they desync. that desync is the mover.

leak_and_entropy.leak_value_high: yes. L_p holes are expensive on purpose. what leaks is the high-value remainder. do not plug every pin.
leak_and_entropy.entropy_is_variance: yes. entropy here is SIGNAL VARIANCE. the spread we need. not chaos to sue.
leak_and_entropy.need: without variance the chromatograph has no peaks. a flat line is a dead culture.
leak_and_entropy.refuse: do not call fleet volume 'entropy we need'. volume is snow. variance is the human step against our still.

pull: sit still at hyperlocal IN. let them move. count movers not bodies. keep the leak. treat entropy as the variance the signal is made of.
